contributions.detail: A TRUE ZERO FILING. Form A (p2) is entirely blank - no ink on any of the ~40 ruled bands, and no strike-out mark. Zero rows against a printed zero, in all three columns, so the scopes coincide.

gates.balance_chain: CLOSES TRIVIALLY: 0 + 0 - 0 = 0 = cover line 4 balance (slashed zero in all three columns). Every printed cell on the cover is a zero glyph and they are mutually consistent.

escalation_note: No escalation needed - nothing on either schedule to escalate, and the cover's twelve zero glyphs are unambiguous at 200 dpi.
